_comment: Vimium C exclusion rules for pages that need raw keyboard input (remote desktops, web terminals). Empty passKeys turns Vimium C off on the page. Apply with vimium-c-exclusions; patterns starting with ^ are regexes matched against the full URL.

rules.what: noVNC client page (Unraid VM console, browser-agent, self-hosted noVNC)
Unraid web terminal and log viewer (ttyd)
Default ports: jlesage GUI apps 5800, noVNC 6080, KasmVNC 6901, ttyd 7681
